instruction:
Parse this Prometheus exposition line into JSON with metric, labels, value and timestamp_ms:
http_requests_total{job="api", code="200"} 1027 1697129107000

Parse this exposition block and return JSON with name, help, type and value:
# HELP http_requests_total Total number of HTTP requests.
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
http_requests_total{job="api"} 42

Parse this StatsD gauge line into JSON with name, value and type:
goroutines:123|g

Parse this StatsD timing line with tags into JSON:
request.duration:45.2|ms|#env:prod,region:eu

Parse this Graphite plaintext line into JSON with path, value and timestamp:
servers.web01.cpu.load 0.42 1697129107

Parse this InfluxDB line protocol line into JSON with measurement, tags, fields and timestamp_ns:
cpu,host=web01,region=us-east usage_user=64.2,usage_system=12.1 1697129107000000000

Parse this Datadog dogstatsd line into JSON with name, value, type and tags:
app.requests:100|c|#service:api,env:prod

Extract the metric names from these four exposition lines as a JSON array:
process_cpu_seconds_total 123.45
process_resident_memory_bytes 8912345
http_requests_total{job="api"} 42
up{job="api"} 1

From these two TYPE lines, return a JSON object mapping each metric name to its type:
# TYPE http_requests_total counter
# TYPE temperature_celsius gauge

This exposition line escapes a comma inside a label value. Parse it and unescape the label as JSON:
log_messages{message="hello\, world"} 3
Write a Python function that parses one Prometheus exposition sample line into a dict with metric, labels and value

Parse this StatsD counter line with a sample rate and return the effective count as JSON:
requests:10|c|@0.1

Parse this StatsD histogram line into JSON with name, value and type:
latency:0.032|h

This exposition sample has no timestamp. Parse it and return timestamp as null in JSON:
process_cpu_seconds_total 123.45

Count the sample lines in this exposition block (ignore HELP, TYPE and EOF) and return JSON:
# HELP up Up status
# TYPE up gauge
up{job="api"} 1
up{job="db"} 1
process_cpu_seconds_total 5.5
# EOF

Parse this up metric line and return instance, value and timestamp_ms as JSON:
up{job="api", instance="10.0.0.5:9100"} 1 1697129107000

Parse this Datadog distribution line into JSON:
app.latency:23.4|d|#env:prod,service:checkout

Parse these two histogram bucket lines and return them as a JSON array of objects with le and value:
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.1"} 120
http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le="0.5"} 340

Parse this Graphite line and compute the free ratio for these two filesystem samples as JSON:
nodes.web01.fs.root.free 512 1697129107
nodes.web01.fs.root.total 1024 1697129107

Convert this Graphite path into a JSON object with host, metric and interval extracted:
web.requests.60.count 25 1697129107
